title: A gap theorem for non-trivial maximal intersecting families and an exact weighted asymptotic
summary: Let $D_n$ be the disjointness graph on the nonempty subsets of $[n]$, whose independent sets are exactly the intersecting families on $[n]$. We study the weighted independent-set polynomial $W(n)=\sum_F\prod_{S\in F}w(S)$, the sum running over these families, for the doubly exponential weight $w(S)=2^{2^{n-|S|}}-1$. The kernel-bearing (trivial) part $Z_\cap(n)$ is exact by inclusion-exclusion and satisfies $Z_\cap(n)\sim n\cdot 2^{3^{n-1}}$.
